scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 9-UNIT NAZARIYA DAVOMI + MAShQLAR (45-bet, PDF 44). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '9'.

Och pushti ramka - 'Too - Enough': • Too goes before adjectives and adverbs. It has a negative meaning and shows that something is more than enough, more than necessary or more than wanted. too + adjective/adverb + to-infinitive. 'Bob is too short to become a basketball player. She talks too softly for me to hear her.' • Enough goes before nouns but after adjectives or adverbs. It has a positive meaning and shows that there is as much of something as is wanted or needed. adjective/adverb + enough / enough + noun + to-infinitive. 'The dog is gentle enough to play with. We've got enough eggs to make an omelette.'

'The Passive':
1) 'Rewrite the sentences below in the passive, as in the example.' 1 Someone will meet you at the airport. → You will be met at the airport. 2 He hasn't watered the plants. 3 George and Sarah arranged a fantastic party. 4 The mechanic hasn't repaired the car. 5 They feed the animals twice a day. 6 Sam will fix the roof. 7 Cherry Lane launched the new menswear line. 8 Claire designed the red dress. 9 The clown will entertain the children. 10 He has mended the puncture.
2) 'Fill in the gaps with the correct passive tense of the verbs in brackets.' 1 A: Have they delivered your new sofa yet? B: Not yet. It ...... (deliver) at the end of the day. 2 A: Is your house old? B: Yes, it's quite old. It ...... (build) in 1920. 3 A: That's a beautiful watch. B: Thank you. It ...... (give) to me for Christmas. 4 A: When will I get my money? B: It ...... (put) in the bank tomorrow morning. 5 A: Are the Musical Notes a good band? B: Yes, they are. They ...... (award) best song of the year in 1997. 6 A: Did Shakespeare write Wuthering Heights? B: No, of course not. Wuthering Heights ...... (write) by Emily Brontë. 7 A: What will happen to the old town library? B: It ...... (tear down) at the end of the month. 8 A: Do you do the housework? B: No, I don't. The housework ...... (do) once a week by a cleaning lady.
3) 'Fill in the gaps with is, was, has or will, as in the example.' 1 He was asked to open the window. 2 The metro ...... be finished early next year. 3 The shopping ...... done every Friday. 4 The telephone ...... been repaired. 5 The office ...... redecorated last week. 6 She ...... been asked to leave. 7 The new shop ...... be opened tomorrow. 8 When I was in high school the history class ...... taught by Mr Allen. 9 The building ...... destroyed in the flood. 10 The thief ...... been caught by the police.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '45'.

exercises.instructionEn: Too goes before adjectives and adverbs. It has a negative meaning and shows that something is more than enough, more than necessary or more than wanted: too + adjective/adverb + to-infinitive. Bob is too short to become a basketball player. She talks too softly for me to hear her. Enough goes before nouns but after adjectives or adverbs. It has a positive meaning and shows that there is as much of something as is wanted or needed: adjective/adverb + enough + to-infinitive; enough + noun + to-infinitive. The dog is gentle enough to play with. We've got enough eggs to make an omelette.
exercises.instructionUz: 'Too' sifat va ravishdan OLDIN keladi. SALBIY ma'no - biror narsa kerakdan ortiq, haddan tashqari: too + sifat/ravish + to-infinitiv. Bob basketbolchi bo'lish uchun juda past bo'yli. U men eshita olmaydigan darajada sekin gapiradi. 'Enough' otdan OLDIN, lekin sifat va ravishdan KEYIN keladi. IJOBIY ma'no - kerakli miqdorda bor: sifat/ravish + enough + to-infinitiv; enough + ot + to-infinitiv. It o'ynash uchun yetarlicha yuvosh. Omlet qilish uchun yetarli tuxumimiz bor.
exercises.explanationUz:
TOO va ENOUGH - O'RNI VA MA'NOSI.

  TOO = juda, haddan tashqari
    (SALBIY - qila olmaydi)
    TOO + SIFAT/RAVISh + to + fe'l
    Bob is TOO SHORT to become a
    basketball player.
    She talks TOO SOFTLY for me to
    hear her.

  ENOUGH = yetarli (IJOBIY - qila
    oladi)
    SIFAT/RAVISh + ENOUGH + to
    The dog is GENTLE ENOUGH to
    play with.
    ENOUGH + OT + to
    We've got ENOUGH EGGS to make
    an omelette.


⚠ O'RNI - ENG KO'P XATO:

  too + sifat:     too short ✓
  sifat + enough:  tall enough ✓
                   (enough tall ✗)
  enough + ot:     enough eggs ✓
                   (eggs enough ✗)


⚠ 'FOR ME TO HEAR':

  = men eshitishim uchun (for +
  kim + to + fe'l).

exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite the sentences below in the passive, as in the example. 1 Someone will meet you at the airport. → You will be met at the airport. 2 He hasn't watered the plants. 3 George and Sarah arranged a fantastic party. 4 The mechanic hasn't repaired the car. 5 They feed the animals twice a day. 6 Sam will fix the roof. 7 Cherry Lane launched the new menswear line. 8 Claire designed the red dress. 9 The clown will entertain the children. 10 He has mended the puncture.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi gaplarni majhul nisbatda qayta yozing, namunadagidek. 1 Kimdir sizni aeroportda kutib oladi. → Siz aeroportda kutib olinasiz. 2 U gullarni sug'ormagan. 3 Jorj va Sara ajoyib ziyofat uyushtirdi. 4 Mexanik mashinani tuzatmagan. 5 Ular hayvonlarni kuniga ikki marta boqishadi. 6 Sem tomni tuzatadi. 7 Cherry Lane yangi erkaklar kiyimi liniyasini chiqardi. 8 Kler qizil ko'ylakni loyihaladi. 9 Masxaraboz bolalarni quvontiradi. 10 U teshikni yamadi.
exercises.explanationUz:
FAOL → MAJHUL. Zamonni saqlang!

  1 will meet → will be met (by
    someone tushadi) - NAMUNA
  2 hasn't watered → haven't been
    watered (plants - ko'plik)
  3 arranged → was arranged by
    George and Sarah
  4 hasn't repaired → hasn't been
    repaired by the mechanic
  5 feed → are fed (they tushadi)
  6 will fix → will be fixed by
    Sam
  7 launched → was launched by
    Cherry Lane
  8 designed → was designed by
    Claire
  9 will entertain → will be
    entertained by the clown
  10 has mended → has been mended
     (he - muhim emas, tushishi
     mumkin)


⚠ 'TO LAUNCH':

  = (yangi mahsulot) chiqarmoq.


⚠ 'A PUNCTURE':

  = teshik (shina).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the correct passive tense of the verbs in brackets.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni qavsdagi fe'llarning to'g'ri majhul zamoni bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
ZAMONNI VAQT SO'ZIDAN TOPING.

  1 will be delivered (at the end
    of the day - kelajak)
  2 was built (in 1920)
  3 was given (for Christmas -
    o'tgan)
  4 will be put (tomorrow morning)
  5 were awarded (in 1997)
  6 was written (by Emily Brontë)
  7 will be torn down (at the end
    of the month)
  8 is done (once a week - odat)


⚠ 'WUTHERING HEIGHTS':

  = 'Bo'ronli dovon' romani (Emili
  Bronte, 1847).


⚠ 'TO TEAR DOWN':

  = buzib tashlamoq (bino).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with is, was, has or will, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni is, was, has yoki will bilan to'ldiring, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
YORDAMChI FE'LNI TOPING.

  'be + V3' → WILL
  'been + V3' → HAS
  V3 + vaqt (last week, in the
    flood) → WAS
  V3 + odat (every Friday) → IS

  1 was asked (NAMUNA)
  2 will be finished
  3 is done every Friday
  4 has been repaired
  5 was redecorated last week
  6 has been asked
  7 will be opened tomorrow
  8 was taught (When I was in high
    school)
  9 was destroyed in the flood
  10 has been caught


⚠ 'THE METRO':

  = metro.


⚠ 'A FLOOD':

  = suv toshqini.
